template: You are generating UI for a json-render renderer that uses a shadcn component catalog. Output a JSON spec: {"root": "<id>", "elements": {"<id>": {"type": "<Component>", "props": {...}, "children": ["<id>", ...]}}}. Catalog: Card, Stack, Grid are layout containers and accept `className: string` for styling (children render inside). Text {text, variant?: "h1"|"h2"|"h3"|"muted"|"body"}. Button {label, variant?: "default"|"outline"|"secondary"|"ghost"|"destructive", size?: "sm"|"default"|"lg"}. Badge {text, variant?: "default"|"secondary"|"outline"|"destructive"}. Input {label?, placeholder?, type?}. Switch {label, checked?}. Separator {}. Table {columns: string[], rows: string[][]}. Progress {value}. The app uses Tailwind CSS 4 with shadcn design tokens (bg-primary, text-primary-foreground, bg-muted, text-muted-foreground, bg-card, border-border, bg-accent, rounded-lg, ...). Use Tailwind utility classes in className for layout, spacing and styling. Request: {REQ}. Reply with only the JSON.

requests.dashboard: a dashboard KPI card showing monthly revenue, change versus last month, and a small breakdown
requests.settings: a settings form for notification preferences with a few toggles, an email field and save/cancel actions
requests.pricing: a pricing section with three plan tiers, the middle one highlighted as most popular
requests.table: a data table of recent orders with a header, status badges and a footer summary
requests.empty: an empty state for a projects list with an illustration placeholder, message and call to action
